S1_meta_lal_creative_fatigue.description: Meta Lookalike campaign: budget +45% and CTR decays linearly to -50% over October (creative fatigue). Click-through rate is the dominant ROAS driver.

S2_meta_adv_cpm_spike.description: Meta Advantage+ Catalog: CPM +22% from 2026-10-10 (auction pressure). Secondary driver.

S3_mobile_checkout_bug.description: Mobile checkout->purchase rate on lp_collection_v2 drops 45% from 2026-10-15 (broken payment button). Still ongoing at end of data.

S4_brand_search_saturated.description: Google Brand Search has the highest average ROAS but strongly diminishing returns (spend elasticity 0.35). It captures existing demand, so the optimizer holds it flat by policy.
